answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing paired with topological cut verifications. A cluster of nodes forming a suspicious hollow partition must bridge a topological cut verified by random peer auditors. Honest clusters act like a solid reef, while unverified Sybil enclaves remain isolated in a staked lagoon. Discovered collusion triggers stake slashing, imposing superlinear cost on the attacker.
